summary: Ran 18 pytest cases against the DAVISPORN preview URL covering public site, video detail embeds, admin dashboard/config/import/purge, sitemap/robots, and cron. All 18 backend tests PASS. Frontend smoke via Playwright confirms real CDN thumbnails, populated category chips, xnxx & xvideos embed iframes on /video/{slug}, and the correct 'Source: xnxx_rapidapi' label. However, during the very first test run the saveSourceConfig POST wiped the RAPIDAPI api_key (see RCA) and the subsequent cron import for xnxx_rapidapi now records 'ERROR: RapidAPI key missing'. Main agent must repaste the RapidAPI key.

critical.issue: Destructive save: any config field omitted from the POST body is force-cleared to empty string in AdminController::saveSourceConfig() via `foreach ($config as $k=>$v) if ($v==='') $merged[$k]=''`. This wiped the persisted xnxx_rapidapi api_key and host when the admin form was posted with only queries+import_limit. XNXX cron/CLI imports now fail with 'ERROR: RapidAPI key missing' until credentials are reentered.

minor.issue: Flash message is delivered via ?msg= query string on the redirect target (not a session flash) — a plain GET /admin after the redirect will not show the confirmation. Not a functional bug, but the review criteria say 'flash Source config saved' visible after reload; tester followed the 302 to see it.
`enabled` inside the JSON blob is `false` while the row's dedicated `enabled` column is `1`. The two flags can diverge; make sure only one is authoritative.

ui_bugs.issue: DB has 12 rows with is_featured=1 and SourceManager::recount() sets 12 featured, but the home Featured grid renders only 8 tiles in the viewport (5 + 3). Review criteria expected 12 tiles.
ui_bugs.selector: Featured section (no data-testid on the grid)

issues: Category chip labels look fine; contrast OK on dark theme.
Featured tiles missing a data-testid attribute making automated tile-count assertions harder — recommend `data-testid=featured-tile-{n}`.

action_items: URGENT: repaste RAPIDAPI_KEY into sources.xnxx_rapidapi.config.api_key (or set RAPIDAPI_KEY env in supervisor php-app block) — tester's first save wiped it because the form was posted without api_key. Command example: `mysql -udav -pdavpass davisporn -e "UPDATE sources SET config=JSON_SET(config,'$.api_key','<KEY>','$.host','porn-xnxx-api.p.rapidapi.com') WHERE slug='xnxx_rapidapi'"`.
Fix saveSourceConfig() so it merges partial updates instead of blanking omitted fields — either drop the `foreach ... if $v==='' $merged[$k]=''` loop or require an explicit 'clear' flag per field.
Bump Featured grid to 12 tiles (or verify the recount cap of 12 is actually being rendered — check dashboard/home limit clauses).
Add data-testid attributes to featured tiles, category chip counts, and video stats row to strengthen automated assertions.
Reconcile sources.enabled column vs config JSON `enabled` — pick one source of truth.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminController::saveSourceConfig destructive merge is a footgun for any partial API-style save; harmful especially with secrets in the same JSON.

Router uses form-encoded `slug` for /admin/source/config and /admin/source/import — a REST-style path (`/admin/source/{slug}/import`) would be clearer and match the data-testids already in use (import-xvideos_csv, save-cfg-xnxx_rapidapi).

Storage of secrets (api_key) in a longtext JSON column is fine but there is no masking on render — the admin form displays the plaintext key in a `type="text"` input. Consider `type="password"` or a masked placeholder.

success_rate.frontend: 90% — only Featured tile count and missing data-testids stand out

seed_data_creation: None. XVideos import was re-triggered once (idempotent, updated 500). XNXX RapidAPI was NOT re-triggered by tests (per quota advisory). Cron endpoint was hit once with the bearer; that fired an async xnxx import which failed fast with 'RapidAPI key missing' — 0 quota consumed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Once RAPIDAPI_KEY is restored, re-run: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_davisporn_feeds.py -v`. Then trigger a xnxx import via CLI once: `cd /app/php && php bin/import.php xnxx_rapidapi 30` — expect 'OK — inserted/updated' in /app/php/storage/logs/import.log and sources.xnxx_rapidapi.last_status. Public URL is https://media-nexus-111.preview.emergentagent.com — no localhost. Age gate is client-side (localStorage `davisporn_age_ok`), server renders content regardless. saveSourceConfig currently wipes any omitted field; when POSTing, ALWAYS include feed_url/api_key/host to avoid data loss.
rca of the issue: Root cause of api_key loss: In /app/php/src/Controllers/AdminController.php lines 169-181, saveSourceConfig builds a $config array from $_POST for feed_url/api_key/host/queries/import_limit. It then merges with existing config via array_filter(fn=>$v!=='') — good. But immediately after, it re-inserts every empty value with `foreach ($config as $k=>$v) if ($v==='') $merged[$k]=''`, deliberately clearing any field that came through empty. When a partial POST (as issued by the first test run) omits api_key/host, PHP defaults them to '' via `$_POST['api_key'] ?? ''`, and the loop then explicitly overwrites the previously-saved secret to ''. Reproduction: `curl -u admin:admin123 -d slug=xnxx_rapidapi -d queries=x -d import_limit=1 https://host/admin/source/config` → api_key becomes empty. Mitigation: (1) remove the explicit-clear loop; (2) or gate it behind a per-field checkbox (`clear_api_key=1`); (3) or read secrets from env only and never write them into config JSON.
